name: AI for Chemistry Club
description: A student-led academic community at HKUST, exploring artificial intelligence, chemistry and related fields of AI for Science.
about: AI for Chemistry Club brings together students interested in the intersection of artificial intelligence and chemical science. We aim to promote learning, discussion and practical exploration of AI approaches in chemistry, while encouraging connections across mathematics, physics, biology and AI itself. Through interdisciplinary exchange and peer mentoring, we aim to help students learn from one another and use AI tools responsibly in scientific research and learning.
learningNote: Learning the foundations matters, too. Understanding AI methods and working with tools such as Git and GitHub can help us build the skills to explore scientific questions together.
activitiesIntro: We aim to bring students together through seminars, reading groups, workshops and student sharing sessions, creating opportunities to discuss ideas and explore AI in practice.
